The wear resistance of cemented carbide with different HEA content was studied by reciprocating friction and wear tester. The grinding samples are Si3N4 balls with Ф 6mm, the load is 70 N, the sliding frequency is 8 Hz/s, the stroke length is 6 mm, and the test time of each sample is 30 min.

The improvement of hardness of steel cemented carbide mainly comes from the strengthening of fine grains and the strengthening of bonding phase. This is because the average grain size of the cemented carbide decreases with the addition of HEA.

the addition of HEA will lead to severe lattice distortion effect, which will enhance the effect of solid solution strengthening, thus strengthening the bonding phase and finally increasing the hardness of cemented carbide.
